dossier.weaponConcept: bulwark rifle (transforming ballistic shield-rifle with modular composite armor, magnetic rail barrel, and dorsal arachnoid cyber-limb rig)

lore.backstory: veteran heavy-breach vanguard of the ruined outer ring who grafted four articulated arachnoid siege-limbs directly into her thoracic exo-spine so she could lock down crumbling bridges solo. she wears a holographic iridescent rain-cape over heavy composite leg plating because looking iconic while eating sniper fire is non-negotiable~ uwu.
lore.syndicateRecord: held a collapsed sector transit hub for 14 hours against three corporate mech platoons without yielding a single centimetre.
lore.psychProfile: warm big-sister energy, unshakeably steady, smiles brightly while her spider-limbs clamp into the asphalt and her shield eats an artillery shell xo.
lore.combatQuote: “i hold the line so you can move forward, bestie~ stay behind the pink glass and start shooting n__n!”

dossier.identity: heavy-breach bastion who plants hardlight ramparts, drops onto the line she is holding and turns every absorbed hit into armor~ n__n

iconFamily.subject: a bold arachnoid siege-limb arch over a single chunky hardlight wall
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Iris. Theme: pink glass. Subject: a bold arachnoid siege-limb arch over a single chunky hardlight wall. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
